decision: Revise the unstarted successor after the completed Kiota test item under explicit owner direction. Adopt F-DISCOVERY-AND-CONFORMANCE; select one staged representation-preserving pilot READY/unstarted, retain the original one-thread READY reserve and rank nine independently gated PLANNED proposals. This is a strategy successor, not a repeated Kiota closure or a scientific launch.

categories.assessment: A broader concrete discovery horizon replaces default return to one historical survivor. Representation testing leads completeness and valid-term generation; the rest diversify failure surfaces without ten ACTIVE items.

Prefer reusable relations, pipeline sentinels and portable vectors. Conditional impact work must first reproduce its premise. Original theorem/CVC gates and all disagreement/survivor evidence remain unchanged.

The Kiota test package is now complete and locally held alongside four Nanoda drafts. Four Arena merges and two Nanoda PRs recorded open are dated ledger observations, not newly refreshed upstream states; no new maintainer request is established. Preserve exact approval/preflight gates. The old operational source assessment stays a feasible but lower-value reserve.

The dated methods map and proposal support a focused source/reuse phase, not a claim that transformation legality or a current methods review is complete. The selected item caps that phase at 90 of 360 active minutes and proceeds within the SAME item if it passes. Other models/generators retain their own review gates.

The selected pilot can begin local source/reuse work without the missing independent transfer package or CVC proof premise. Its format/oracle/controller preparation is bounded inside one item. Do not repeat the completed transfer search or relabel known data as unobserved.

candidates.rationale: Selected first: a legal representation relation offers shared discovery value beyond the completed small-test portfolio and narrower historical one-thread reserve.
Second: direct pipeline assurance and a known checked-object warning signal; receipt observability is the key missing contract.

blockers.reason: PLANNED: name supported producer/adapters, checked-object receipt semantics, independently expected module contents and a fault rubric in a staged bounded plan; then record promotion. Exact phase gates follow within that item. No item-specific staged execution protocol has yet been recorded; this is a concrete promotion gap, not an external authorization blocker.
